hints.text: Look at what the two points have in common. A matching coordinate means the points sit on one vertical or horizontal line.
Both points have $x = 2$, so the distance is the gap between the $y$-values $5$ and $-3$. Set up $|5 - (-3)|$ and turn the subtraction into addition.
$|5 - (-3)| = |5 + 3| = 8$, so the points are $8$ units apart.

explanation: Both points have the same $x$-coordinate, $2$, so they lie on a vertical line.
On a vertical line the distance is the absolute value of the difference of the $y$-values: $|5 - (-3)|$.
Subtracting a negative is the same as adding, so $|5 - (-3)| = |5 + 3| = 8$.
The distance between the points is $8$ units.
